Dragonborn_Bard
Lyrux Goldthroat is a Bard who performs in the Guildhall within the Lower City Sewers.
“
I'm sorry, sweetie pie - I don't do requests. But toss me a few coppers and I'll shoot you a saucy wink across the bar.
„
— Lyrux Goldthroat

Involvement

As a Dragonborn, she can be asked if she knows any of  Quil's songs. This option also appears as the  Dark Urge if Quil has been encountered by knocking out  Alfira prior to her joining the party in camp. She does indeed know Quill, but Baldurian people prefer Baldurian songs and she does not take requests.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Bardic Inspiration ( + )

Inspire an ally to go beyond their capabilities with your performance. They can add a +1d6 bonus to their next Attack roll, Ability check, or Saving throw.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
